propositions: An optional, disabled-by-default, read-only local web UI renders a per-ticket audit page showing plan-review, completion-verification, and code-review gate decisions alongside ticket details.
The audit page exposes each review's full four-pass breakdown (pass-1 findings, pass-2 verification, pass-3 determination with thresholds, pass-4 coaching) and per-finding resolved block_threshold.
The page must navigate retained history for both plan review and code review, allowing selection of an older (not just latest) round which renders distinct content.
The completion panel renders per-criterion rows of {criterion, met, citation, kind} produced by story C's criteria[].
The feature is a pure consumer of enriched fields delivered by the data-enrichment epic and must not proceed to render a region until its Epic 1 field source has landed.
When disabled (default) or with the [ui] extra not installed, no web dependency is imported and rebar behaves exactly as today.
